unitTitle: Nombres 11-20 et base dix - Leçons complètes

strengths: Clear single learning goal for each lesson
weaknesses: Some lessons attempt to cover multiple concepts simultaneously
Decision points could create complexity for inexperienced teachers
Vocabulary load might be heavy for some lessons

strengths: Logical sequence from 11-12 to 20, then extending to 30
Incorporates review and consolidation lessons strategically
Scaffolds from concrete to abstract representations
Includes formative assessment and adaptation points
weaknesses: Some lessons could benefit from more explicit connections to prior learning
Pacing might be too rapid for struggling learners in certain sections

strengths: Strong real-world connections in every lesson
Uses student collections and personal interests
Game-based learning reflects how children naturally learn
weaknesses: Some real-world connections feel forced rather than natural
Could include more diverse cultural contexts
Assessment approaches could be more varied and authentic

verdict: APPROVED - This unit exceeds the 85% threshold with strong pedagogical design, clear progression, and meaningful real-world applications. The systematic approach to building number sense with concrete manipulatives and visual representations is exemplary for Grade 1 mathematics.
